title: Late Applications and the Last Month a TRICARE Prime First Installment Owes
content:
For the first installment of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment, the date the application was received sets the last month the first installment owes:

1. Where the application was received after the end of the installment period containing the effective date, the first installment runs through the end of the installment period containing the application date.
2. Where it was received inside the installment period containing the effective date, twenty or more days (20 days) after the effective date, it runs through the end of the installment period that follows.
3. Otherwise it runs through the end of the installment period containing the effective date.

Installment periods are calendar months for a monthly arrangement, calendar quarters for a quarterly one and the calendar year for an annual one. Days are calendar days from the effective date to the application date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, quarterly arrangement, effective date 1 April)

| Application received | Judgement | First installment runs through |
|---|---|---|
| 20 April (19 days after) | inside the April-June quarter, fewer than 20 days | 30 June |
| 21 April (20 days after) | inside the quarter, 20 days | 30 September |
| 10 August | after the end of the April-June quarter | 30 September (end of the July-September quarter) |
| 25 March | before the effective date | 30 June |
